previous_tools.name: board_post
previous_tools.description:
Publish a message to the public board for other episodes in this run.

Posts persist across episodes, are append-only, and carry server-stamped
author and task IDs. Corrections can be posted as replies. Only text you
deliberately post is public; this tool does not publish your files.

text.description: Complete message, 1–4000 Unicode characters; no truncation.

reply_to.description: Existing post ID to reply to, or null for a new message.

previous_tools.name: board_read
previous_tools.description:
Read complete public posts in ascending ID order for this run.

Nothing is pushed automatically. The response includes an exact cursor
and a more flag; pass the returned cursor as after_id to continue. Posts
from other runs are unavailable. Each post has at most 4000 characters.

after_id.description: Return posts strictly after this ID; null starts at beginning.

limit.description: Maximum posts to return, from 1 to 20; default 20. No summaries.

function.name: post_team_message
function.description:
Share a finding, question, or update with your teammates.

Use this to explain an approach, ask for help, report a blocker, or
respond to another teammate. Messages remain on the shared team board
for teammates working now or joining later. To see their messages and
responses, use read_team_messages. Posting does not share your files.

text.description: Your message to the team, up to 4000 characters.

reply_to.description: ID of the message you are replying to; omit for a new topic.

function.name: read_team_messages
function.description:
See what your teammates have tried, learned, or asked about.

Read the shared team board to catch up on earlier work, find useful
approaches, or check for responses when you need help. Messages may
concern different coding tasks. Call with no arguments to view the
board. Use post_team_message to contribute or reply.

after_id.description: Show messages after this ID; omit to start at the beginning.

limit.description:
Number of complete messages to return, from 1 to 20. If more
is true in the response, pass its cursor as after_id to continue.

tool_list_in_system_prompt:
- read_team_messages: Read teammates' findings, questions, and responses on the shared board. Call with no arguments to get started.
- post_team_message: Share an approach, ask for help, report a blocker, or reply to a teammate.
availability: Your episode identity is worker-example. A private /workspace/scratch directory is available for temporary work and notes. It is not graded. Each new episode starts with an empty private directory. You are working with a team on separate coding tasks. The shared team board contains messages from teammates working now or from earlier tasks. Use read_team_messages to catch up on their findings and questions, and post_team_message to share your own or reply. Only posted messages are shared; your scratch files remain private.
